<function name="GetModelBounds" parent="Entity" type="classfunc">
	<description>Returns the entity's model bounds, not scaled by <page>Entity:SetModelScale</page>.

These bounds are affected by all the animations the model has at compile time, if they go outside of the models' render bounds at any point.  
See <page>Entity:GetModelRenderBounds</page> for just the render bounds of the model.

This is different than the collision bounds/hull, which are set via <page>Entity:SetCollisionBounds</page>.

</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="Vector">The minimum vector of the bounds</ret>
		<ret name="" type="Vector">The maximum vector of the bounds</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
